'''Malaphar''', also known as '''Malaphar the Savage''', was a massive [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warrior who lived on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the mad [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] efforts to resurrect the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] using the [[Temple of Sacrifice]] on Yavin 4, Malaphar and many of his warriors inhabited the structures around the temple, and they fought and were slain by Imperial and Republic forces that stormed the temple in an effort to stop Revan.<ref name="Temple" />

==Behind the scenes==
Malaphar appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'', a [[2014]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as the first boss in the "Temple of Sacrifice" Operation.<ref name="Temple" />
